decisions.statement: A window is seven days wide and is named by the day the window ends.
A set counts only where that set names a movement this knows.
A set outside the window is neither counted nor passed over.
The effort a set counts at is handed in rather than read here.
Nothing here says what a count is owed against.
The day a set falls on is read from the day that set names.

definition: the sets a trailing week of training held, counted by muscle and by pattern
